description: This PHP class 'PimCsvDataImportService' provides functionality for importing CSV data related to PIM (Personal Information Management) into the OrangeHRM system. It defines header row values, manages an instance of a CSV data import service, and performs import operations for employee data.

classes.name: PimCsvDataImportService
classes.description: A service class responsible for importing PIM-related CSV data into OrangeHRM, handling CSV header definitions and delegating to a core CSV import service.

methods.name: getCsvDataImportService
methods.description: Returns an instance of CsvDataImportService, instantiating it if necessary.

methods.name: setCsvDataImportService
methods.description: Sets the CsvDataImportService instance used by this service.

methods.name: import
methods.description: Performs CSV import for PIM data given the file content, delegating to the core CSV import service with predefined headers.
